# Ingest an external sample

1. Read the device's capture permissions and retention settings for this channel. If they exclude storage, record the gap in the enclosing capture if permitted. Keep personally identifying details out of the gap description.
2. Use the device, recording session and sequence range to identify the sample. Copy an accepted payload without resampling or transcoding. For a file, compare its byte count and SHA-256 digest with the received bytes. Capture a scalar in its supplied precision and unit.
3. Write the sample note with the original timestamps, clock, format, channel and calibration identifier when available. Link the stored file by its exact name. For a partial payload, preserve the received range and identify the missing part. Mark an unknown unit or timestamp explicitly.
4. On repeat ingestion, reuse a verified record with the same identity and bytes. If the bytes differ for that identity, retain the variants under distinct names and flag the conflict. Put the sample note's link into the enclosing capture. A later interpretation can cite the file's frame, byte range or time offset through this note.

## Implementation interface

```text
record Sample(device, channel, session, sequence, device_time, payload, format, quality, retention)
ingest_sample(packet: SensorPacket, retention: CapturePolicy, store: Vault) -> Sample | Gap
```
